summary: 8-K filed 2026-11-03 for event date 2026-11-03 (material current report). Filing excerpt: EX-99.1 2 q32026991.htm EX-99.1 Document NEWS RELEASE Contact Carolyn Guss AMD Communications corporate.pressinquiry@amd.com Liz Stine AMD Investor Relations investor.relations@amd.com AMD Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results AMD delivers record quarter as Data Center segment revenue grows 97% year-over-year, driven by record sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs SANTA CLARA, Calif. ― November 3, 2026 ― AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Third quarter revenue was $13.4 billion, gross margin was 54%, operating income was $2.8 billion, net income was $2.4 billion and diluted earnings per share was $1.46. On a non-GAAP(*) basis, gross margin was 56%, operating income was $3.9 billion, net income was $3.5 billion and diluted earnings per share was $2.09. “We delivered a record quarter with revenue exceeding the high end of our guidance as Data Center segment sales nearly doubled year-over-year,” said Dr. Lisa Su, AMD chair and CEO. “Demand for our Instinct and EPYC products continued to strengthen, and we expect growth to accelerate further in the fourth quarter as we scale Helios and ‘Venice’ production. With our leadership product portfolio and deep customer and supply chain relationships, we are confident in our ability to sustain very strong revenue growth and expanding profitability over the coming years.” “Third quarter revenue grew 45% year-over-year to a record $13.4 billion, while non-GAAP earnings per share grew 74%, demonstrating the significant operating leverage in our business model as our Data Center business drives scale,” said Jean Hu, AMD executive vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer. “Our fourth-quarter outlook reflects accelerating revenue and earnings growth, driven by strong demand across our Data Center portfolio.” 1 GAAP Quarterly Financial Results Q3'26 Q3'25 Y/Y Q2'26 Q/Q Revenue ($M) $13,377 $9,246 Up 45% $11,536 Up 16% Gross profit ($M) $7,210 $4,780 Up 51% $6,203 Up 16% Gross margin 54% 52% Up 2 ppts 54% Flat Operating expenses ($M) $4,378 $3,510 Up 25% $4,213 Up 4% Operating income ($M) $2,832 $1,270 Up 123% $1,990 Up 42% Operating margin 21% 14% Up 7 ppts 17% Up 4 ppts Net income ($M) $2,428 $1,243 Up 95% $2,297 Up 6% Diluted earnings per share $1.46 $0.75 Up 95% $1.38 Up 6% Non-GAAP(*) Quarterly Financial Results Q3'26 Q3'25 Y/Y Q2'26 Q/Q Revenue ($M) $13,377 $9,246 Up 45% $11,536 Up 16% Gross profit ($M) $7,483 $4,992 Up 50% $6,488 Up 15% Gross margin 56% 54% Up 2 ppts 56% Flat Operating expenses ($M) $3,560 $2,754 Up 29% $3,394 Up 5% Operating income ($M) $3,923 $2,238 Up 75% $3,094 Up 27% Operating margin 29% 24% Up 5 ppts 27% Up 2 ppts Net income ($M) $3,471 $1,965 Up 77% $2,760 Up 26% Diluted earnings per share $2.09 $1.20 Up 74% $1.66 Up 26% Segment Summary • Data Center segment revenue was a record $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for AMD EPYC™ processors and the launch of AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs....
